newsitem.title: UK: Shell plans power generating drive -paper.
newsitem.headline: Shell plans power generating drive -paper.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch oil and energy group Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc is planning a major move into power generation, the Sunday Telegraph newspaper said.
The paper said the drive was part of an effort to extend Shell's business interests beyond its core oil and gas production operations and had been decided by Shell's committee of managing directors.
It said Shell was expected to slowly develop the business, which would given it an end use for its natural gas reserves, but said acquisitions had not been ruled out.
Shell was not immediately available for comment on the report.
